shortDescription: Create, modify, or delete baseline profile

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: cluster
options.description: List of cluster(s) for baseline profile creation. This parameter is required when I(state) is C(present) and while creating a new profile.

options.name: days
options.description: Required days of a week on when the job must run. This is required when I(state) is C(present) and while creating a new profile.

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of the OpenManage Enterprise Modular.

options.name: job_wait
options.description: Whether to wait till completion of the job.

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. The job is tracked only for this duration. This is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: repository_profile
options.description: Repository profile for baseline creation. This is required when I(state) is C(present) and while creating a new profile.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates a baseline profile or modifies an existing profile if the profile with the same name already exists. C(absent) deletes the baseline profile. I(repository_profile), I(cluster), I(days) and I(time) is required when creating a new baseline profile. Either I(profile_name) or I(profile_id) is required when I(state) is C(absent).

options.name: time
options.description: Time at when the job must run, and is 24 hours format. The format must be HH:MM. This is required when I(state) is C(present) and while creating a new profile.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to check SSL certificate. - If C(true), the SSL certificates will be validated. - If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated.

options.name: vcenter_password
options.description: Password for OpenManage Enterprise Integration for VMware vCenter (OMEVV). If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_PASSWORD=password

options.name: vcenter_username
options.description: Username for OpenManage Enterprise Integration for VMware vCenter (OMEVV). If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_USERNAME=username

options.name: vcenter_uuid
options.description: Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of vCenter. vCenter UUID details can be retrieved using M(dellemc.openmanage.omevv_vcenter_info) module. If UUID is not provided, then the environment variable E(OMEVV_VCENTER_UUID) is used. Example: export OMEVV_VCENTER_UUID=uuid
